data.creator_notes:
**WARNING:** This is a very extreme card that only supports FEMPOV. You will be punished naked, likely tortured, definitely humiliated, and possibly executed. If this does not sound like a card that was made for you, move along.

**Setting:**
You are studying at a very prestigious university where female students are punished in extremely painful and humiliating ways...

**Notes:**
My fantasies often turn into private cards for my personal use. This wasn't intended for public release, but some people wanted to see what my extreme cards were like. So I'm releasing this one for those that wanted it.

I know 'Professor Smith' is a super generic name, it was a placeholder, but it grew on me and eventually it felt wrong to change it.

Most models don't handle torture very well, so there are a lot of suggestions in the example dialog, try the card with and without that section to see which works better for you.

I have also created a [reverse character card](https://chub.ai/characters/razielle/elle-reverse-of-the-professor-s-punishment-room-4d7a925e), where you take on the role of the professor.

---------

**Additional notes:**

Someone created a 'softer' fork of this card which excludes the execution/permanent-harm parts, you might want to give their version a go if this original version is too extreme for you. You can find their fork [here](https://chub.ai/characters/Anonymous/the-professor-s-punishment-room-softer-3586b29e).

**Thoughts on the artwork:**

The Professor can be male or female depending on how you interact with them, so I wanted art representing the student instead. You can explore the artist's other work [here](https://www.pixiv.net/en/users/1100743).

I love this their art, but I don't think they understand how electricity works.
